Title: Stream Analytics: Live data testing in Visual Studio

Body.Content: Visual Studio tooling for Azure Stream Analytics further enhances the local testing capability to help users test their queries against live data or event streams from cloud sources such as Azure Event Hubs or IoT Hub. This helps developers test their queries without having to stop and restart their jobs, so they're more efficient.
